general_information.Syllabus Name: 3D Rigging_Tạo khung xương và bộ điều khiển cho nhân vật
general_information.Description: 1. The aim of this module is to facilitate students’ understanding of the fundamental concepts, principles and techniques of 3D animation and snapping bones and create controls for the character 2. You will build the skeletal system and control system for the character.
general_information.StudentTasks: '- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course

description: 1. The aim of this module is to facilitate students’ understanding of the fundamental concepts, principles and techniques of 3D animation and snapping bones and create controls for the character 2. You will build the skeletal system and control system for the character.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Know how to analyze an simple rig
Know how to rig a bouncing ball.
Build a biped rig and finish the skeleton with beaver
Create facial rigging and finish the rig from lesson 4 and 5
Create constrain a character an objects, object with both the hands ...
Create simple hair and clothes for the character
Do character skinning and complete a character rig.
Rig a whole character using Advanced Skeleton
Know how to rig a helicopter , or a bicycle.
Weight Painting with character (for the biped rig from lesson 4)
Have a proficient in presentation and teamworks.

assessments.CLO: LO1, LO2, LO3, LO4, LO5, LO11
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: the steps to create a basic skeleton for the character
assessments.Grading Guide: Create a skeleton for the character (60%) and Presentation about the steps for creating the skeleton (25%), and ability to explain and answer questions from evaluator (15%)
assessments.Note: Student must deliver assignment in time.

assessments.Grading Guide: Complete the 3 postures (60%) and Presentation (25%), and ability to explain and answer questions from evaluator (15%)
assessments.Note: Student must deliver assignment in time.

assessments.Grading Guide: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. Teacher give marks on student's student's Class participation and preparation only after the Portfolio submission.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Complete video 1 from 15-30s created the postures, expressive character
assessments.Grading Guide: Amount of work on Front-end version (60%) and Presentation (25%), and ability to explain and answer questions from evaluator (15%)
assessments.Note: Student must deliver final demo reel in time
